title: Zoot.cz Product Scraper
description: Scrape product data from Zoot.cz. Provide a Zoot.cz URL or a search keyword. Supports search pages, category pages, and subcategory pages.

url.title: URL
url.description: Full Zoot.cz URL to scrape (search, category, or subcategory). Takes priority over keyword. Examples: https://www.zoot.cz/vyhledavani/hledani:shirt/ or https://www.zoot.cz/damske/

keyword.title: Search Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword if not using a direct URL. Ignored when URL is provided.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to visit (48 products per page).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (recommended: residential) to avoid blocks.
